messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Increased 95th percentile latency and error rate for tenant 'borealis' in region us-west1 (dedicated pool). Impact: generation requests failing with 503s. PagerDuty: P12345.

alice (oncall): ACKed. pulling logs now. tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime. --paging in progress.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 assigned to alice (oncall). Escalation policy: 15m -> eng-sre.

ben (eng-sre): I'm looking at the pool. Dashboard shows spike at 12:03 UTC, GPU memory pressure + OOM on some nodes. Probable kernel-level OOM killer on a subset of the dedicated nodes. Link: https://dash.redwood.example.com/tenants/borealis/pool/us-west1

alice (oncall): Can we isolate affected nodes and route traffic away? Need quick mitigation while we warm other region.

dan (eng-runtime): Affirm. Starting warm capacity in us-west2 now. Will provision 4 nodes with same instance type and quantized model. Running the warm script:

```
# warm capacity helper
rcli capacity allocate --tenant borealis --region us-west2 --pool-type dedicated --count 4 --instance g5.12x
rcli deploy-model --tenant borealis --region us-west2 --model redwood-3b-q4 --replicas 4
```

ben (eng-sre): Good. Meanwhile isolating bad hosts in us-west1: marking as draining and removing from LB.

```
# drain hosts
consul kv put /pools/borealis/us-west1/drain true
kubectl label node gpu-23 pool=drain --overwrite
```

alice (oncall): Eli from customer side — are any live batch jobs hitting the tenant? @eli pls confirm.

eli (customer-ops): We have a rolling import job that runs every hour, might be hitting it. I'll pause the job for now.

carla (acct-exec): Informing customer named contacts: sending short note: "We're seeing elevated errors in us-west1; failover to us-west2 initiated; minimal expected disruption. We'll follow up with ETA once warm-up completes."

ben (eng-sre): Health checks on new pool failing initially due to KMS access for model encryption. Adding KMS grant for us-west2 nodes now.

```
# add KMS grants
kms-client grant --key borealis-key --principal arn:aws:iam::infra:role/us-west2-warm
```

dan (eng-runtime): KMS OK. Starting model load. Health endpoint coming up.

# canary test
curl -X POST https://us-west2.api.redwood.example/tenants/borealis/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'

alice (oncall): Canary passed (200, latency 280ms). Ready to shift traffic. Plan: weighted routing via Route53 (10% -> us-west2, 90% -> us-west1) for 10m, then 50/50, then full cutover if stable. Rollback plan: revert weights to previous immediately if error rate exceeds 2% or 95p latency > 800ms.

ben (eng-sre): Preparing Route53 change batch. Lower TTL first (set to 30s) to enable fast rollback.

```
# example change
{
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "borealis.api.redwood.example",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "us-west2",
        "Weight": 10,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "10.2.3.5"}]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

alice (oncall): Executed TTL change. Now applying weighted record.

ben (eng-sre): Weight change done. Starting at 10%. Monitoring metrics and logs.

(alarm emote) ben (eng-sre): minor spike in 503s for a small subset of requests hitting us-west2 — looks like a model variant mismatch for a specific prompt path (reranker module). Rolling a config fix to match model config.

```
# quick rollback to old model variant if needed
rcli deploy-model --tenant borealis --region us-west2 --model redwood-3b-q4 --replicas 4 --variant stable
```

dan (eng-runtime): Pushed variant fix. Errors dropped back to baseline. Continuing ramp.

alice (oncall): 10m elapsed, metrics look stable. Increasing weight to 50%.

ben (eng-sre): 50% in place. Watching p95 and error rate. No customer-facing errors reported.

carla (acct-exec): Messaging update sent to customer: "We've shifted 50% of traffic to a warm pool in us-west2; performance is stable. We'll continue monitoring and finalize cutover once p95 remains within SLOs for 30 minutes."

eli (customer-ops): Noted. No impact on live sessions from our side. Thanks for the transparency.

alice (oncall): After 30m stable at 50%, proceeding to 100% shift and then decommissioning drained nodes in us-west1. Finalizing DNS to point fully to us-west2.

ben (eng-sre): Applied final Route53 update to make us-west2 primary and set weight 100. Old hosts in us-west1 will be wiped once traffic is stable for 1 hour.

```
# wipe drained hosts after verification
consul kv put /pools/borealis/us-west1/terminate true
terraform apply -var 'tenant=borealis' -var 'region=us-west1' -target=module.dedicated_pool
```

alice (oncall): Handing incident to dan for runtime postmortem and remediation tracking. dan, please own follow-up: root cause analysis (OOM traces), mitigation to prevent recurrence (kernel tuning, eviction settings, memory cgroup), and capacity automation to warm cross-region earlier.

dan (eng-runtime): Taking it. I'll open a postmortem ticket and link required changes. Tentative follow-ups: adjust node-level cgroup memory, add proactive warm capacity policy for enterprise tenants with low RTO, and add a model-variant compatibility check during deploy.

carla (acct-exec): I'll follow up with the customer on SLA credits and provide timeline for the full remediation PR.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. Marking incident P12345 as mitigated. We'll keep this thread for the postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P12345 status updated: mitigated. Full incident report link: https://incidents.redwood.example/reports/P12345
